mechanism: Citalopram may potentiate bradycardia and hypotension through additive effects on cardiac conduction and sympathetic inhibition, compounded by systemic absorption of ophthalmic timolol.
action: Monitor heart rate and blood pressure regularly; consider alternative antidepressant if bradycardia or hypotension develops; ophthalmic route minimizes systemic exposure but caution warranted in patients with cardiac conduction abnormalities.
